subject: Onboarding to Arpentum AP Portal — PO numbering & tax evidence
messages:
From: Sofia Rinaldi <sofia.rinaldi@arpentum.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arpentum.com
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 08:42:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding & PO numbering — Arpentum

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call last week. We're ready to add Redwood as an approved supplier in Arpentum's AP portal. Two quick asks from our side to make sure invoices flow cleanly into our system: 

1) PO numbering: our PO numbers will come as ARP-<region>-<6 digits> (example ARP-EU-004321). Can you confirm Redwood can place the exact PO string in the invoice "Reference" field and also include it in the line item description when the PO contains multiple lines? Our ERP requires an exact match to auto-apply.

2) Tax documentation: for EU VAT reconciliation we need a VAT registration certificate (or EU VAT self-cert) and the vendor legal name matching the invoice header. If you have a combined AP onboarding packet that includes bank remit, VAT cert, and legal entity mapping, please upload to the portal or attach here.

I attached a short onboarding checklist and the portal invite. If anything in the packet needs review on your side (for example remit instructions that require KYC), flag it and we'll loop in our finance team.

Regards,

Sofia Rinaldi
Senior Procurement Manager
Arpentum S.p.A.
procurement@arpentum.com

Attachments: Arpentum_onboard_checklist.pdf (1 page)
Portal invite link: https://vendor.arpentum.com/onboard/ABCD-1234

Quick answers below and attaching our AP packet (PDF) and a PO XML example that shows where the PO string will be populated.

- PO placement: We will always populate the PO reference field exactly as provided. Our billing generator can also repeat the PO string in each line description if the invoice references multiple lines — we'll default to repeating the PO at the line-level for multi-line invoices to help your matching rules.

- Legal name & VAT: Our registered EU legal entity is Redwood Inference Europe Ltd. We have the VAT certificate for that entity (attached) and will ensure the invoice header uses that legal name. If Arpentum requires any additional wording on the VAT cert or a translated name, let us know.

Attachments: Arpentum_vendor_form_20280328.pdf; PO-numbering-spec-example.xml

Next steps I propose: 
- Karthik (cc) to confirm bank remit formatting and whether we need separate remit per legal entity.
- Neha (cc) to confirm we deliver the VAT cert + EU legal name on all future invoices and whether a self-cert is required in addition to the certificate.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick screen share if the portal has fields that look non-standard.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: procurement@arpentum.com, Sofia Rinaldi <sofia.rinaldi@arpentum.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding & PO numbering — Arpentum

Hi Sofia / Arpentum AP team,

On Thu, 28 Mar 2028 at 10:15, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick answers below and attaching our AP packet (PDF) and a PO XML example that shows where the PO string will be populated.

Thanks for the packet, Marissa — confirming a couple of technical details from Redwood's treasury side so there are no delays when invoices are paid: 

1) Bank remit: Redwood uses two EU remit accounts depending on the invoice currency and entity. We'll provide a remit mapping table in the portal upload. Please confirm whether Arpentum's portal supports per-invoice "Beneficiary tax ID" and a freeform "Remit reference" field. Some ERP integrations overwrite beneficiary fields; if your system strips remit references out of the XML we need a fallback (e.g., PO applied + invoice number).

2) PO split/incrementing: If Arpentum's PO contains sub-line identifiers (for partial acceptance), will the portal allow multiple invoice attachments referencing the same base PO but different line refs? Our billing automation can emit multiple invoices per PO but needs the PO base string present on each.

3) Payment terms & early-pay: We can accept net30 by default for Arpentum EU accounts; if early-pay is available we'll register the eligible invoices. Who should sign the finance annex (if required)? We can countersign electronically (DocuSign link).

Please let us know the portal field names for "PO reference", "Invoice reference", and "VAT attestation type" so we can map programmatically.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: remit-mapping.csv (will upload), finance-annex-draft.pdf

From: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@arpentum.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Rinaldi <sofia.rinaldi@arpentum.com>, procurement@arpentum.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 17:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding & PO numbering — Arpentum

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the clear responses and the attachments. A few confirmations from AP: 

- Portal fields: "PO Reference" (string), "Line Reference" (optional string), "Invoice Reference" (string), "VAT Evidence Type" (enum: certificate | self-cert | none). The fields exist in the API and CSV upload.

- PO splits: the portal allows multiple invoice uploads per base PO with distinct Line Reference values. We will not force a single combined invoice. Your automation producing multiple invoices per PO is fine as long as the base PO string is present both in PO Reference and in each line description.

- Remit handling: the portal supports a "Beneficiary Tax ID" and a freeform "Remit Reference". The XML import we use preserves both fields into the ERP if they are present. If you upload a remit-mapping.csv in the portal we'll validate it; procurement@arpentum.com will reply if any KYC is required.

- Finance annex: please send the draft finance annex to procurement@arpentum.com. We'll send a DocuSign sign request to the Redwood signatory once Arpentum's legal finishes a quick review.

We're good to proceed — I'll trigger the vendor activation after you upload the packet and remit mapping. Expected lead time ~3 business days after complete upload.

Best regards,

Luca Bianchi
AP Integration Lead
Arpentum S.p.A.

Action items (internal):
- Marissa: upload AP packet and remit-mapping.csv to vendor portal today.
- Neha: ensure VAT certificate is the correct certified copy for Redwood Inference Europe Ltd.
- Karthik: finalize finance annex countersignature details and prepare remit mapping file.
